content: The fruit falls not far from the parent tree; cultivate your own soil if you wish your children to flourish.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: Sib az derakht door nemiofteh (سیب از درخت دور نمی‌افتد)
explanation: Parents lecture their children for hours on honesty, patience, and kindness, while privately gossiping, raging in traffic, and chasing money. Children rarely listen to our lectures; they absorb our unspoken aroma like sponges. Be the tree you wish them to grow from.
practicalInsight: Lead by immaculate personal example today rather than verbal lectures. Let your conduct speak.
reflectionPrompt: What flaws in the next generation are actually direct reflections of the examples we have modeled for them?
